title: Holiday Bulb Workshop Party - Make it-Take Christmas Centerpiece
seo_title: Holiday Bulb Workshop: Make a Christmas Centerpiece
description: This is a hands-on holiday workshop where you plant four Paperwhite bulbs for Christmas blooms and add festive accents to take home as a centerpiece. Horticulturist Abby Jackson leads the instruction, all supplies are included, and refreshments are provided. It takes place Friday, November 20, 2026, at 6 pm at the Extension Building, 186-A N. Adams in Lebanon, MO; the cost is $15, with registration and payment due by November 12 (call 417-532-7126).
